newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh ex-president Ershad in hospital.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh ex-president Ershad in hospital.

text.p: Former Bangladesh president Hossain Mohammad Ershad has been admitted to a cardiovascular hospital in Dhaka after suffering chest pain, the official BSS news agency said on Monday. It said Ershad, chief of the Jatiya Party, was hospitalised early on Monday and was in the coronary care unit. Doctors told BSS they would be able to comment on Ershad's condition in three days.

Ershad, 68, a former army general who seized power in a 1982 bloodless coup, was ousted in a people's uprising in December 1990 and sent to jail. He was released on bail last January to attend parliament after he was elected a Jatiya Party legislator in the June 1996 polls, which he contested from prison.
